topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I step carefully through the overgrown grass, the sun barely breaking through the thick canopy above. My tools clink softly as I kneel down, the earth cool beneath my fingers. The ground offers up its secret with a thud and a rustle of roots. My breath catches as I uncover the metal box, its surface marred by time and nature. I can't shake the sense that something is amiss; this wasn’t a childhood stash, not one of my pranks. The air feels heavier, the trees whispering secrets. I hesitate, fingering the rusty latch, wondering what part of my past—or perhaps someone else’s—awaits inside.
